goal: Let DC-Agent proactively suggest relevant department memories during business conversations without silently injecting memory into the user prompt before explicit confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Department memory suggestions are approved-only: candidates must come from governed approved public/internal memory and must exclude need_review, rejected, merged, stale, secret, and sensitive_blocked records.

Natural department keywords may create a suggested state, but the runtime must not auto-inject memory into the current user prompt, conversation history, or <dc_agent_memory_context> before explicit confirmation.
After explicit confirmation for the pending suggestion_id in the same conversation, the original request is resumed and the approved-only memory context may be applied as a transient reference.
Explicit memory lookup requests skip the proactive prompt and keep the existing approved-only direct recall path.
The suggestion lifecycle must support suggested, confirmed, dismissed, expired, and blocked states, and each suggest/confirm/dismiss/expire/apply transition writes an append-only audit record.

runtime_policy.save_policy: Suggestions and transient memory references are not saved as ordinary user content.
runtime_policy.priority_policy: Confirmed department memory is lower-priority reference context and must not override the user's current prompt, supplied source material, or verified facts.

non_goals: Do not implement bulk proactive review pings.
Do not recall unapproved or sensitive-blocked memory.
Do not automatically update SOP, routing, or department profiles from suggestions.
Do not require an Obsidian realtime watcher for this runtime step.
Do not treat generic confirmation text as valid unless there is an active same-conversation suggestion.
